g.title: ClawEvalIntegration
g.text: ClawEval Integration: Eval Factory + NeMo Gym
Original ClawEval agent, tools and graders · three task splits · three seeded trials

g.text: Recipe registration and cluster / model selection

g.text: Preparation, trial scheduling, process isolation and result collection

g.text: Supplied NVIDIA fork; existing agent behavior and scoring

g.text: Called by the original ClawEval runner

g.title: factory
g.text: Pins Gym; forwards native paths, profiles and policy endpoint

g.text: Gym JSONL: public prompt, task ID, split, task.yaml hash

g.title: core
g.text: Server lifecycle · schedule task / trial rows
Slurm driver runs on the host: container: null

g.title: adapter
g.text: Validate task / prompt · forward settings · timeout / cancellation cleanup

g.title: projection
g.text: Mean score · Pass@1 · Pass@3 · strict Pass³

g.title: runner
g.text: Original agent loop + native model provider
Task prompts · tools · media · simulated user
Task-specific turn limits and native configuration preserved

g.title: output
g.text: Native JSONL traces, media, logs and workspaces
Task / runtime / profile hashes retained for provenance
Pass@3 and strict Pass³ require three completed trials per represented task

g.title: grade
g.text: Grader fixtures staged after the agent finishes
Round to 4 decimals · pass when score ≥ 0.75

g.title: sandbox
g.text: Native tool execution and per-trial workspace
Task assets, media and installed sandbox packages

g.title: policy
g.text: Factory-served model or native profile endpoint

g.title: judge
g.text: Simulated user for enabled multi-turn tasks

g.title: legend
g.text: Color identifies ownership. Solid arrows: execution / results. Dashed arrows: configuration / collection.
